name: HTML
description: The standard markup language for structuring content on the web.

name: CSS
description: The stylesheet language used to control the presentation and layout of HTML documents.

name: Responsive Design
description: Techniques for building layouts that adapt to different screen sizes and devices.

name: JavaScript
description: A high-level, dynamic programming language used for web page interactivity and, via Node.js, server-side logic.

name: DOM
description: The Document Object Model, a programming interface for HTML/XML documents that scripts use to read and manipulate pages.

name: Browser APIs
description: Built-in browser interfaces such as fetch, localStorage, and the History API used by client-side JavaScript.

name: HTTP
description: The application-layer protocol used for communication between clients and servers on the web.

name: React
description: A JavaScript library for building component-based user interfaces.

name: React Hooks
description: Functions such as useState and useEffect that let function components manage state and side effects.

name: Component Architecture
description: Principles for structuring UIs as composable, reusable components.

name: Frontend Testing
description: Techniques and tools for testing UI components, interactions, and rendering behavior.

name: Web Performance
description: Techniques for optimizing load time, rendering speed, and runtime responsiveness of web applications.

name: Accessibility
description: Practices for making web applications usable by people with disabilities (a11y).

name: Node.js
description: A JavaScript runtime built on Chrome's V8 engine that allows JavaScript to run outside the browser.

name: npm / Modules
description: Node's package manager and module system used to share and consume reusable code.

name: Asynchronous JavaScript
description: Patterns such as callbacks, Promises, and async/await used to handle non-blocking operations.

name: Event Loop & Concurrency
description: The mechanism Node.js uses to handle asynchronous operations on a single thread.

name: Express
description: A minimal, flexible Node.js web application framework used to build APIs and web servers.

name: Routing
description: The mechanism for mapping HTTP requests to handler logic based on URL path and method.

name: Middleware
description: Functions that execute during the request/response cycle to handle cross-cutting concerns like logging, auth, and error handling.

name: REST APIs
description: An architectural style for designing networked applications around stateless, resource-oriented HTTP endpoints.

name: Authentication
description: The process of verifying the identity of a user or system.

name: Authorization
description: The process of determining what an authenticated user or system is permitted to do.

name: Database Integration
description: Techniques for connecting backend applications to databases, including ORMs and query builders.

name: Backend Architecture
description: Principles for structuring server-side applications for maintainability, scalability, and separation of concerns.

name: Backend Security
description: Practices for protecting server-side applications from common vulnerabilities and attacks.

name: Backend Testing
description: Techniques for unit, integration, and API testing of server-side applications.

name: Linux
description: The open-source operating system family widely used to run servers and containers.

name: Git
description: A distributed version control system used to track changes in source code.

name: Networking Fundamentals
description: Core concepts such as IP addressing, DNS, ports, and protocols that underlie distributed systems.

name: Cloud Computing
description: The on-demand delivery of compute, storage, and other IT resources over the internet.

name: AWS Core Services
description: Amazon Web Services offerings such as EC2, S3, RDS, and IAM commonly used to run cloud applications.

name: Docker
description: A platform for packaging applications and their dependencies into portable containers.

name: Containerization
description: The practice of packaging software with its dependencies so it runs reliably across environments.

name: CI/CD
description: Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery/Deployment practices for automating build, test, and release pipelines.

name: GitHub Actions
description: A CI/CD platform built into GitHub for automating workflows such as testing and deployment.

name: Deployment
description: The process and strategies for releasing application changes to production environments.

name: Monitoring & Logging
description: Practices and tools for observing system health, performance, and behavior in production.

name: Infrastructure Concepts
description: Foundational ideas about servers, networks, and infrastructure-as-code that support running applications.

name: Database Fundamentals
description: Core concepts of what databases are and why structured data storage matters.

name: Relational Modeling
description: The practice of representing data as related tables with keys and constraints.

name: SQL
description: Structured Query Language, used to define, query, and manipulate relational data.

name: CRUD Operations
description: Create, Read, Update, and Delete — the fundamental operations performed on stored data.

name: Joins
description: SQL operations that combine rows from two or more tables based on related columns.

name: Aggregations
description: SQL operations such as SUM, COUNT, and GROUP BY used to summarize data.

name: Normalization
description: The process of organizing relational data to reduce redundancy and improve integrity.

name: Schema Design
description: The practice of designing tables, relationships, and constraints for a database.

name: Constraints
description: Rules such as primary keys, foreign keys, and unique constraints that enforce data integrity.

name: Transactions
description: Units of work that group multiple database operations so they succeed or fail together.

name: ACID
description: Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, and Durability — the guarantees relational transactions provide.

name: Indexes
description: Database structures that speed up data retrieval at the cost of additional storage and write overhead.

name: Query Optimization
description: Techniques for analyzing and improving the performance of database queries.

name: Concurrency Control
description: Mechanisms databases use to manage simultaneous access to data safely.

name: AI/ML Fundamentals
description: Foundational concepts distinguishing AI, machine learning, and deep learning, and how ML systems learn from data.

name: Python
description: A high-level programming language widely used for data science and machine learning.

name: NumPy
description: A Python library for efficient numerical computing with multi-dimensional arrays.

name: Pandas
description: A Python library for data manipulation and analysis using DataFrames.

name: Statistics & Probability
description: Mathematical foundations for reasoning about data, uncertainty, and inference used throughout ML.

name: Supervised Learning
description: ML approaches that learn a mapping from inputs to known output labels.

name: Unsupervised Learning
description: ML approaches that find structure or patterns in unlabeled data.

name: Classical ML Algorithms
description: Traditional algorithms such as linear/logistic regression, decision trees, and k-means.

name: Model Evaluation
description: Techniques and metrics for assessing how well a model performs and generalizes.

name: Feature Engineering
description: The process of creating, transforming, and selecting input variables to improve model performance.

name: Overfitting & Generalization
description: The phenomenon where a model fits training data too closely and fails to generalize, and techniques to prevent it.

name: Deep Learning
description: A subfield of ML using multi-layer neural networks to learn representations from data.

name: Neural Networks
description: Computational models inspired by the brain, composed of layers of interconnected units.

name: Transformers
description: A neural network architecture based on self-attention that underlies most modern language models.

name: Large Language Models
description: Transformer-based models trained on large text corpora to generate and understand language.

name: Embeddings
description: Dense vector representations of data used to capture semantic similarity.

name: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
description: An architecture that combines information retrieval with generative models to ground LLM outputs in external data.

name: AI Application Architecture
description: Patterns for building production applications powered by ML models and LLMs.

name: Analytics Fundamentals
description: Foundational concepts of how data is used to answer business questions and support decisions.

name: Data Cleaning
description: Techniques for identifying and correcting errors, duplicates, and inconsistencies in data.

name: Excel
description: A spreadsheet application widely used for data entry, calculation, and analysis.

name: Excel Formulas & Functions
description: Built-in Excel functions such as SUM, IF, and lookup functions used to calculate and transform data.

name: Lookup Functions
description: Excel functions such as VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, and XLOOKUP used to retrieve matching data across ranges.

name: Pivot Tables
description: An Excel feature for summarizing, grouping, and aggregating large datasets interactively.

name: Charts & Data Visualization
description: Techniques for representing data visually to reveal trends and support decisions.

name: Power Query
description: A data connection and transformation tool used in Excel and Power BI for ETL workflows.

name: Power BI
description: A business analytics tool for building interactive reports and dashboards.

name: DAX
description: Data Analysis Expressions, the formula language used in Power BI and Power Pivot for calculations.

name: KPIs
description: Key Performance Indicators used to measure progress toward business objectives.

name: Business Analytics
description: The practice of using data analysis to drive business decisions and strategy.

name: Dashboard Design
description: Principles for designing clear, effective, and actionable data dashboards.
